name: Cookie
summary: Cookie tends the crew's cauldrons aboard the juggernaut deep in the Deadmines. A murloc among the Defias Brotherhood, he cooks beneath the watch of Captain Greenskin and Edwin VanCleef. In the underground dry dock, he is the only entirely optional boss.

sections.title: The Brotherhood's Chef
sections.body: Cookie cooks beneath the decks of the towering juggernaut in Ironclad Cove. No human outrider or goblin engineer takes the duty; the solitary murloc does. How Cookie came to hold the position is unknown. The rest of the crew may doubt a murloc's cooking, but pirates rarely choose their meals with care. In Moonbrook's underworld, a meal is a meal.

sections.title: A Bitter Brew
sections.body: Cookie patrols the waterways and shores around the pirate flagship. He wields cooking utensils and throws acidic brews. Though apart from typical murloc tribes, he defends his cauldron with savage force, flinging caustic mixtures at intruders who enter the docks. His station lies away from the main gangplanks, so many who storm the cove pass his kitchen by. Cookie is the only overseer aboard the Defias juggernaut who can be bypassed.

faq.q: Why is a murloc working as a cook for the Defias?
aliases: why is cookie on the ship
faq.answer: No record explains how Cookie came to serve aboard the juggernaut. Defias outlaws and goblin shipwrights accept the arrangement because pirate crews take food where they can get it, whatever the cook's species.

faq.q: Where can Cookie be found in the Deadmines?
faq.answer: Cookie is at Ironclad Cove, at the very end of the Deadmines. He patrols the shallow water and docks near the stern of the giant wooden juggernaut, just past the ramp guarded by Mr. Smite.

faq.q: Is Cookie required to finish the Deadmines?
aliases: do you have to kill cookie
faq.answer: No, Cookie is the only optional boss in the Deadmines. Infiltrators can board the vessel and confront Captain Greenskin and Edwin VanCleef without disturbing the cook's patrol along the shore.

faq.q: Does Cookie belong to a specific murloc tribe?
faq.answer: Cookie is not associated with any known local murloc tribe, including those along the Westfall coast. He lives and works among the outlaws and scoundrels of the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: What weapons or attacks does Cookie use?
faq.answer: Cookie fights at close range with cooking implements and hurls caustic splashes of acid at attackers, burning them with dangerous culinary mixtures.

faq.q: Who does Cookie report to on the juggernaut?
faq.answer: Cookie serves the naval arm of the Defias Brotherhood under Captain Greenskin's command, and ultimately answers to Edwin VanCleef.

angles.text: Finding a murloc as chief cook aboard an outlaw juggernaut speaks to the desperate, unrefined standards of pirate cuisine.
VanCleef's rogue network relies on strange, unconventional assets. Cookie is one of the odd surprises in the Brotherhood's supply lines.
Stormwind's scouts may be surprised to find murlocs working within Defias leadership, rather than only along Westfall's outer shores.
